newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Boots Co ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Boots Co ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Friday it affirmed its ratings for The Boots Company Plc at long-term A plus and short-term A1.

"The strength of earnings from the core Boots The Chemists chain underpins both group progress and the current ratings. Progress continues at Boots Opticians and Halfords which both made a positive contribution to group profits in FY96," IBCA said in a statement.

It said the poor contribution from Do-It-All and AG Stanley remained a cause for concern, though signs of a recovery in the British housing sector, and the action taken to reorganise the operations and build brand strength, should limit the downside.

"Further investment will be required in Boots Healthcare International and Boots Contract Manufacturing if the company is to achieve its ambitions for a portfolio of global self-medication products," IBCA said.

But with strong post financing cash flow and net cash in excess of 500 million stg, Boots has some room for growth through acquisition, despite the outflow of 300 million stg in June 1996 on the group's second share repurchase within the last 18 months, the rating agency said.
